title: Binance hackers stole $6.3 billion in record-breaking crypto heist

claims.claim: Binance platformundan 6.3 milyar dolar değerinde kripto fonu çalındı.

evidence.quote: Binance has disclosed that $6.3 billion worth of crypto funds have been stolen from the platform

claims.claim: Etkilenen varlıkların yaklaşık 3 milyar doları şu ana kadar donduruldu.

evidence.quote: around $3 billion of the impacted assets have been frozen so far.
and that around $3 billion of the impacted assets have been frozen so far.

claims.claim: Binance, kullanıcı varlıklarını korumak için yaklaşık 1.3 milyar dolarlık acil durum rezerv fonuna sahip.

evidence.quote: The company has an emergency reserve fund of around $1.3 billion (at last valuation) to protect user assets in these situations

claims.claim: Binance, bu olayı karşılamak için 6.34 milyar dolardan fazla şirket fonu ayırdı ve bunun 5 milyar doları etkilenen token varlıkları olarak tutuluyor.

evidence.quote: said it has also reserved over $6.34 billion of company funds to cover this incident — $5 billion of which is “already held in the exact token assets that were impacted.”
and said it has also reserved over $6.34 billion of company funds to cover this incident — $5 billion of which is “already held in the exact token assets that were impacted.”

claims.claim: Binance, bir DevOps mühendisinin ele geçirilen dizüstü bilgisayarının saldırganın bir servis konteynerine erişmesine izin verdiğini açıkladı.

evidence.quote: The company shared details about the compromised laptop that belongs to one of its DevOps engineers in a prior update, saying it allowed an attacker to access a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions.

claims.claim: Blokzincir analiz firmaları TRM ve Chainalysis saldırıyı Kuzey Koreli siber suç grubu TraderTraitor'a atfediyor.

evidence.quote: blockchain analysis firms TRM and Chainalysis both attribute it to TraderTraitor, a North Korean cybercrime hacking group that has a history of stealing funds from cryptocurrency exchanges.
blockchain analysis firms TRM and Chainalysis both attribute it to TraderTraitor, a North Korean cybercrime hacking group

claims.claim: Bu hack olayı, geçen yıl Bybit'ten çalınan 1.46 milyar dolarlık rekorun dört katı büyüklüğündedir.

evidence.quote: This is the largest known cryptocurrency heist in history— four times higher than the previous record, when $1.46 billion was stolen from Bybit last year

claims.claim: Binance 2019 yılında da bir güvenlik ihlali yaşamış ve o dönemki değerle 40 milyon dolar değerinde kripto varlık çalınmıştı.

evidence.quote: This isn’t the first time Binance has been hacked, having suffered a previous security breach in 2019 in which $40 million worth of crypto assets (valued at the time) were stolen.
